title: Prepare pinned labeled datasets and honest evaluation partitions
description:
## Scope

Prepare AG News and Emotion as initial datasets while preserving the history of which splits have already been used. Freeze candidate, development, and scoreboard partitions without redistributing source text.

## Definition of done

Reproducible loaders, frozen text-free manifests, label mappings, duplicate exclusion, and documented prior-use status for every proposed study.
